The plate looks like a square dinner plate, about 24–26 cm across. On it is a small mound of plain white rice, roughly 8×10 cm and a few centimetres high, plus a few scattered grains and a faint trace of sauce. That works out to about 90 g of cooked rice, which at roughly 1.3 kcal/g gives about 117 kcal. Adding a little for the sauce/oil traces brings it to about 125 kcal.
